T: Two cops. One shower. Zero patience.
D: Two rival LA cops are framed and have to break out of prison together.
P: Serve the mains when the armoured RV rolls out.
S: Bologna and cheese on griddled white.
Bologna, yellow mustard and American cheese on white bread, griddled in butter under a weight until crisp.
Beef and bean chili ladled into bowls, saltine crackers on the tray.
Brown the mince with the onion and garlic. Stir in the chilli powder and cumin. Add the tomatoes, beans and a cup of water and simmer until thick. Season. Ladle into bowls with crackers on the side.
Franks dipped in cornmeal batter and fried golden, yellow mustard to dip.

Pat the frankfurts dry and push a skewer into each. Whisk the cornmeal, flour, baking powder and a pinch of salt, then the egg and buttermilk, into a thick batter. Pour into a tall glass. Heat the oil to 180C. Dip each frankfurt in the batter and fry, turning, until deep golden. Drain and serve with mustard.
M: Beef patties simmered in brown onion gravy, green beans on the side.

Mix the mince, breadcrumbs, egg and salt and shape into 4 oval patties. Brown the patties on both sides and set aside. Fry the onions in the same pan until soft and brown, then stir in the flour. Whisk in the stock and Worcestershire, return the patties and simmer until cooked through. Boil the beans until tender and serve beside the patties.
Breakout glazed meatloaf and mashed potatoes
Beef and pork loaf, sticky tomato and brown sugar glaze, buttery mashed potatoes and minted peas.

Beef and pork meatloaf with a sticky tomato and brown sugar glaze, thick slices on buttery mash with minted peas. Mix 500g beef mince, 300g pork mince, 1 grated onion, 60g breadcrumbs, 1 egg, 2 tbsp Worcestershire and salt. Shape into a loaf in a lined tin. Mix 80ml tomato sauce with 2 tbsp brown sugar and 1 tbsp vinegar, spread over and bake at 180C for 60 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes, mash with 60g butter and 100ml hot milk. Cook 300g frozen peas 3 minutes and toss with butter and mint. Rest the loaf 10 minutes before slicing.
W: Vanilla cupcakes with pink buttercream and sprinkles, for Kiki.
Vanilla cupcakes baked at 180C for 18 minutes, piped with pink buttercream and covered in sprinkles.
K: Cola over ice with cherry syrup and a twist of orange.
Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Add 2 tbsp cherry syrup to each, top with cold cola and stir once. Drop in a cocktail cherry and twist a strip of orange peel over the top.

s.note: Bologna and cheese on griddled white.
s.how: Spread 8 slices white bread with 20g yellow mustard. Layer 120g devon and 80g American-style cheese between the slices to make four sandwiches. Butter the outside using 30g softened butter. Griddle over medium heat under a weighted pan for 3 minutes each side until crisp and the cheese melts. Cut each into fingers to share.

s.note: Beef and bean chili ladled into bowls, saltine crackers on the tray.
s.how: Brown the mince with the onion and garlic. Stir in the chilli powder and cumin. Add the tomatoes, beans and a cup of water and simmer until thick. Season. Ladle into bowls with crackers on the side.

m.note: Beef patties simmered in brown onion gravy, green beans on the side.
m.how: Mix the mince, breadcrumbs, egg and salt and shape into 4 oval patties. Brown the patties on both sides and set aside. Fry the onions in the same pan until soft and brown, then stir in the flour. Whisk in the stock and Worcestershire, return the patties and simmer until cooked through. Boil the beans until tender and serve beside the patties.

w.note: Vanilla cupcakes with pink buttercream and sprinkles, for Kiki.
w.how: Beat 80g softened butter with 80g caster sugar until pale. Beat in 1 egg and 1 tsp vanilla extract. Fold in 100g self-raising flour and 40ml milk. Divide between 8 cupcake cases and bake at 180°C conventional for 18 minutes until a skewer comes out clean. Cool completely. Beat 60g softened butter with 120g icing sugar and 1 tsp milk until fluffy; tint with a little pink food colouring. Pipe onto the cupcakes and cover with 20g sprinkles. Serve two small cupcakes each.

d.note: Cola over ice with cherry syrup and a twist of orange.
